components.description: Medical leave for a regular faculty member who must be absent for illness or other disability, for up to six months (or until long-term disability eligibility, if sooner), on physician documentation; the leave itself (U6), its salary is c4.
components.mechanism_note: U6: the text grants an absence ('In order for a medical leave to be granted'; 'University-paid disability leave'); coded as the leave plus its pay (c4 within it). Childbirth is not given a period of its own; 10.2.3 lists maternity among personal leaves and refers to 13.6.
components.eligible_parent_wording: Regular faculty who must be absent for illness or other disability
components.entitlement_note: The leave is granted on physician documentation (an application the institution grants when the condition is certified); the word 'ordinarily' qualifies the once-in-two-years limit (coded in use_limit).
components.medical_certification_note: the faculty member’s physician should provide documentation attesting to the need for the leave
components.duration_note: Up to six months, or until eligibility for long-term disability payments if sooner; where possible coinciding with the fall (July 1–December 31) or spring (January 1–June 30) semester. For grant-supported faculty the length follows medical need but should not exceed six months, salary paid from the grants subject to funding.
components.relief_note: Department arranges coverage of the faculty member's responsibilities during University-paid disability leave.
components.use_limit_note: No more than one six-month medical leave will ordinarily be granted within a two-year period.

notes: Governing document: the Handbook of Academic Administration (faculty handbook). The edition in force on 2018-02-22 was not saved; 2018_03 (January 1, 2017) and 2018_04 (August 2, 2018) bracket it and agree on every parental provision coded here except 'Temporary teaching funds are provided' (2018_03, 2018_02) versus 'may be provided' (2018_04) for parental teaching relief; the bracketing was accepted, so every handbook component carries version_uncertain. 2018_05 lists the August 2018 changes; none touch leave or parental provisions.

2018_00_link is a 2015 capture of Chapter 13 (older than the reference period); its 13.6.1 wording ('Non-regular Faculty on a multi-year contract ... eligible for six weeks' leave with salary') differs from both handbook editions; the handbook editions govern. 2018_01 is a 2019 summary page (relief and the one-year extension), consistent with the handbook.

Calendar: semesters (relief 'one semester'; extensions 'four academic semesters'); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. The fall (July 1-December 31) / spring (January 1-June 30) dates in 13.6 are administrative pay periods, not term length.

Birth parent chain: medical leave c3 (up to 6 months, salary c4 within it, if certified disabled) with FMLA c6 concurrent and RIPFML c7 concurrent with FMLA; Parental Teaching Relief c1 (one semester of classroom teaching relief, in the semester of the birth or the next) with no order stated against the medical leave, so left unlinked; tenure extension c2.
Non-birth parent chain: FMLA c6 (12 weeks) with RIPFML c7 concurrent; Parental Teaching Relief c1 if primary caregiver (no link to the statutes stated); tenure extension c2.

Not components: sabbatical, junior and post-tenure sabbatical, scholarly leave, leave on special assignment and fellowship top-ups (scholarly purposes, HAA 13.1-13.4); course buy-out (7.4.2); faculty and dependent care travel funds (7.8.1-7.8.2); child care subsidy and dependent care FSA (2018_01); benefits continuation during leave (13.8); course bunching (2018_04 22.16, added August 2018, not for parents).
